- Alcohol

- Avocado (persin — worse for other animals than dogs, but pit/skin are also choking/obstruction hazards)
- Fatty foods, fried foods, bacon grease — can trigger pancreatitis
- Bones, especially cooked bones (splinter risk, obstruction/perforation)
- Salt in large amounts
- Nutmeg
- Raw eggs (salmonella risk, plus long-term biotin interference)
- Milk/dairy in quantity (most dogs are lactose intolerant to some degree)

- Unripe tomatoes and potatoes, and any green parts of the plant (solanine)
